name: Cosmic Crossfire: Noctilume Triarch
summary:
Face the swarm. Fight back. Defeat the boss.
Cosmic Crossfire: Noctilume Triarch is a single-player VR arcade shooter inspired by the '90s. Hold your ground on a platform suspended in space as winged enemies pour through glowing portals.
Aim your space gun and raise your shield to block incoming fire. You can't shoot while shielding, so choose your openings carefully. Shoot floating power-ups to draw them toward you, restore health, boost your firing rate, and unlock auto fire for the run.
